title: Electron flow through the respiratory chain
compartment: Inner mitochondrial membrane; cytochrome c in the intermembrane space

steps.note: 4 H+ out of the matrix per NADH; complex II also reduces ubiquinone
Q cycle: 4 H+ released outside, 2 H+ taken from the matrix per ubiquinol
Per 2 electrons: 2 H+ pumped out; 2 matrix H+ and ½ O2 form H2O
